messages:
anna: quick ping — can someone take a look at https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/2723? This is the Starlake Health VPC PSK rotation patch (terraform + onboarding script). Need to get this merged before their maintenance window tomorrow morning.

ci-bot: CI started: infra-tests · commit 9b2f1c4 · running :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dmitri: on it, will do a quick pass now. main thing to check is the tfvars toggle and the migration step.

chandra: tagging in — looking for compatibility with older agents (some customer edge nodes still on 1.8). if the script overwrites /etc/vpn/psk without backup that's a hard no. can you add a rollback step?

anna: good call — I added a backup step in the script and noted a reversible flag. snippet: `mv /etc/vpn/psk /etc/vpn/psk.bak.$(date +%s)` then write new PSK.

leo: small nit in terraform: resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "starlake_vpc_psk" needs `overwrite = true` to apply during rotation. otherwise it fails in our CI apply simulation.

dmitri: thanks — left one inline comment on the tf file and one suggestion in the script. otherwise looks fine to me. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI passed: infra-tests · commit 9b2f1c4 · all checks green :white_check_mark:

chandra: verified the script locally against an agent container (1.8) — backup + restore works. approving from my side.

ops-bot: Reminder: merge freeze between 23:00-02:00 UTC. Starlake maintenance window is 08:00 UTC tomorrow, so merging now is fine if deploy is coordinated.

anna: awesome — thanks all. Dmitri, can you merge after CI passes (it's green) and ping me so I can coordinate the deploy with Starlake?

dmitri: merging now, will ping when deployed. :rocket:

ci-bot: PR merged: #2723 by dmitri · deploy pipeline triggered..
